summary: The shared V1 60-variant media ceiling prevented the explicitly requested full photo configurators. Raise V1 studio/schema/public validator capacity to a bounded 1024, preserve V2's 60 limit, and keep exact immutable media families. Also remove the compatibility test's fixed nine-site count so a genuine new site does not fail the legacy regression.
evidence: Owner explicitly requested full professional photo configurators on 2026-10-18
Source catalogue has up to 179 unique option illustrations on one model; observed 60-variant ceiling in studio and public validator
Original content-v2 regression failed 10 !== 9 after the tenth valid site was compiled
rollback: Revert paired shared media-cap commits before importing a package above 60 V1 variants; do not rewrite an existing release. Keep site assets/packages local until rights are confirmed.
